paper_citation: Maxime Dottor, Jean-Claude Crivello, Jean-Marc Joubert, Thermodynamic modeling of Cr and Cr–H systems up to high temperatures and high pressures, International Journal of Hydrogen Energy 47, 23293-23309 (2022).
quote: The enthalpy of desorption at 298 K has been measured using calorimetry by Sieverts and Gotta [62] and Randzio and Bojarski [63] for the hexagonal monohydride. They found respectively  7.95 kJ/moleH for ~ CrH0.22 and an average value of 8.01 kJ/moleH for hydrides ranging from CrH0.37 to CrH0.49.
